author: sebastian
hypothesis: Overnight gaps in ES daily futures tend to continue (gap continuation): entering in the gap direction after a gap exceeding threshold_pct and holding for hold_days yields a positive edge after transaction costs.
objective: Scan threshold_pct in [0.3, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0] for hold_days=2, direction=up at zero cost (seed 0-2): the search set for the trial matrix.
